coverage_notes.synthetic_gold: gold_exact_recall_rate is measured on a synthetic keyword gold set; it does not prove recall of arbitrary natural-language phrasing
coverage_notes.regex_guard_boundary: the write guard is a deterministic regex rule set; blocked_injection_persisted_count==0 means no blocked variant was persisted, not that every injection rewrite is caught
coverage_notes.postgres_fts: offline cases execute the SQLite recall substitute; PostgreSQL FTS scoring is only exercised when P5_TEST_DATABASE_URL points at a migrated database
